summary: Home Dashboard responsiveness fix verification - ALL BREAKPOINTS PASSED. Tested responsiveWidth prop implementation across 6 viewport widths (390, 768, 1024, 1180, 1365, 1440). No horizontal overflow detected. Progress rail correctly hidden. Nova widget positioned without overlap.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Home responsiveness fix verified. responsiveWidth prop is correctly passed from app/(tabs)/index.tsx to all Home child components. Components use actual content width (not raw viewport) for breakpoint decisions. Desktop sidebar (256px) is accounted for in layout calculations.

mobile_390px.notes: Full-width mobile layout, no sidebar, Nova compact FAB

tablet_768px.notes: Tablet layout, no sidebar, content adapts correctly

laptop_1024px.notes: Desktop sidebar (256px) appears, content width 768px - layout adapts correctly

medium_desktop_1180px.notes: Sidebar + 924px content area - no cramped/overlapping composition

desktop_1365px.notes: Hero pulse card repositions correctly for wider layout

desktop_1440px.notes: Full desktop layout, all components render correctly

home_not_responsive_across_devices.evidence: All 6 breakpoints pass without horizontal overflow or clipped content

executive_overview_band_desktop_sidebar_.evidence: Band adapts correctly within actual dashboard content area (256px sidebar offset accounted for)

hero_section_cramped_at_medium_desktop.evidence: Hero section uses responsiveWidth prop for breakpoint decisions, not raw viewport width

progress_rail_overlap.evidence: Progress rail threshold raised - not visible at tested widths (expected behavior)

nova_launcher_overlap.evidence: Nova widget positioned correctly without overlapping hero pulse card at all breakpoints

home_loads_after_login.evidence: Login successful, home dashboard loads with all key sections visible

root_cause_confirmation: Root cause was correctly identified: Home sections were using raw useWindowDimensions viewport width even inside the desktop AppShell where the left sidebar reduces actual usable content width. The fix measures actual home-screen layout width in app/(tabs)/index.tsx and passes responsiveWidth into child Home components.
